archetypes.name: VP Rush
archetypes.philosophy: Abandon traditional military buildup in favor of early VP donations when costs are lowest. Win by reaching 1000 VP before the opponent can organize a defense.
key_changes: Update BulletSpending.spendPolicy(): Set VP donation start to round 300 instead of 1500
Update BulletSpending.getDonateAmount(): Donate aggressively with reserve of only 20-30 bullets
Update BulletSpending.shouldHireGardener(): Reduce hire chance to 0.005f - minimal economy
Update BulletSpending.shouldPlantTree(): Disable tree planting (set to 0.0f) - VP > economy
Update BulletSpending.shouldBuildSoldier(): Reduce to 0.005f - token defense only
archetypes.engagement_style: Avoid major combat. Scouts for vision and harassment only. Survive and donate.

archetypes.name: Early Soldier Swarm
archetypes.philosophy: Overwhelm the opponent in the first 500 rounds before they can establish defenses. Mass soldiers targeting enemy production units.
key_changes: Update BulletSpending.spendPolicy(): Maximize gardener hiring at 0.04f for rounds 0-300
Update BulletSpending.shouldBuildSoldier(): Increase to 0.05f for first 600 rounds
Update BulletSpending.shouldPlantTree(): Reduce to 0.01f - minimal economy, all-in aggression
Update BulletSpending.shouldBuildScout(): Disable (0.0f) - focus purely on soldiers
Update BulletSpending.getReserveForRound(): Set early reserve to 50f for max unit production
archetypes.engagement_style: Aggressive all-in pushes. Target enemy gardeners and archons first. No retreat.

archetypes.name: Tank Fortress
archetypes.philosophy: Build a core of heavy tanks that slowly advance, destroying everything in their path. Tanks body-damage trees and absorb massive punishment.
key_changes: Update BulletSpending.spendPolicy(): Add TANK to build options with 0.015f priority
Update BulletSpending.shouldBuildSoldier(): Reduce to 0.01f - supplement with tanks
Update BulletSpending.shouldPlantTree(): Increase to 0.04f - need bullet income for expensive tanks
Update BulletSpending.shouldHireGardener(): Maintain 0.02f for sustained production
Update BulletSpending.getReserveForRound(): Higher reserves (150f early) to afford 300-bullet tanks
archetypes.engagement_style: Slow, methodical advancement. Use pentad shots for maximum damage. Tanks clear forests by walking through them.

archetypes.name: Scout Swarm Harassment
archetypes.philosophy: Mass produce cheap scouts (80 bullets vs 100) to harass enemy gardeners, collect bullets from trees, and control vision. Scouts move through trees and have superior speed/vision.
key_changes: Update BulletSpending.shouldBuildScout(): Increase to 0.04f - mass scout production
Update BulletSpending.shouldBuildSoldier(): Reduce to 0.008f - minimal backup
Update BulletSpending.shouldPlantTree(): 0.02f - moderate economy for sustained swarm
Update BulletSpending.shouldHireGardener(): 0.02f - support swarm with gardeners
Add Tank build at very low priority (0.003f) for late-game tank conversion if needed
archetypes.engagement_style: Hit-and-run harassment. Target isolated gardeners. Use superior speed to kite. Shake trees for bullets.

archetypes.name: Tree Economy Titan
archetypes.philosophy: Maximize tree farming early to create overwhelming late-game bullet income. Trees produce 1 bullet/round at full health after 80-round maturation.
key_changes: Update BulletSpending.shouldPlantTree(): Increase to 0.08f - maximize tree planting
Update BulletSpending.shouldHireGardener(): Increase to 0.03f for first 800 rounds - more planters
Update BulletSpending.shouldBuildSoldier(): Reduce to 0.012f - minimal defense early
Update BulletSpending.getReserveForRound(): Very high reserves (200f early) to fund massive tree planting
Update BulletSpending.getDonateAmount(): Start VP donations at round 2000 with massive bullet surplus
archetypes.engagement_style: Defensive early game. Let trees mature. Late-game overwhelming force from bullet surplus.

archetypes.name: Lumberjack Forest Clear
archetypes.philosophy: Use lumberjacks to clear forests (chopping deals 5 damage) and strike multiple enemies at once in melee. Excellent on dense maps like Clusters.
key_changes: Update BulletSpending.spendPolicy(): Add LUMBERJACK priority at 0.035f
Update BulletSpending.shouldBuildSoldier(): Reduce to 0.015f - support with ranged
Update BulletSpending.shouldPlantTree(): 0.02f - moderate economy
Update BulletSpending.shouldBuildScout(): 0.01f - scout for lumberjacks
Update BulletSpending.getReserveForRound(): 80f - lumberjacks are cheap (100 bullets)
archetypes.engagement_style: Close-quarters combat. Strike damages all nearby enemies simultaneously. Clear trees to open paths and release contained units/bullets.

archetypes.name: Defensive Turtle
archetypes.philosophy: Build dense tree walls around archon, use pentad shots from soldiers behind cover. Force opponent to break through defenses while accumulating VP.
key_changes: Update BulletSpending.shouldPlantTree(): Increase to 0.06f - dense defensive walls
Update BulletSpending.shouldBuildSoldier(): 0.025f - defenders behind trees
Update BulletSpending.shouldHireGardener(): 0.025f - maintain defensive production
Update BulletSpending.getDonateAmount(): Start VP donations at round 1200 - moderate timing
Update BulletSpending.getReserveForRound(): 100f - balanced for defense + VP
archetypes.engagement_style: Static defensive positions. Use pentad shots through tree gaps. Let enemy come to you. Counter-attack when they overextend.

archetypes.name: Archon Assassin
archetypes.philosophy: All units prioritize killing enemy archons above all else. Archons have 400 HP but killing them instantly wins via elimination (no more gardener hiring).
key_changes: Update BulletSpending.shouldBuildScout(): 0.025f - fast scouts to find archons
Update BulletSpending.shouldBuildSoldier(): 0.025f - soldiers to kill archons
Update BulletSpending.shouldPlantTree(): 0.02f - sustain but don't over-invest
Update BulletSpending.shouldHireGardener(): 0.02f - steady production
Modify targeting logic: Only target ARCHON, ignore everything else until archons dead
archetypes.engagement_style: Obsessive archon hunting. Scouts find archon locations and broadcast. All units converge on archon. Ignore enemy soldiers unless they block path.

archetypes.name: Bullet Starvation
archetypes.philosophy: Control the map to deny enemy access to neutral trees containing bullets. Starve opponent of resources while maintaining steady production.
key_changes: Update BulletSpending.shouldBuildScout(): 0.03f - control map and shake trees
Update BulletSpending.shouldBuildSoldier(): 0.02f - secure controlled areas
Update BulletSpending.shouldBuildLumberjack(): 0.015f - harvest trees before enemy
Update BulletSpending.shouldPlantTree(): 0.025f - secure own bullet income
Update BulletSpending.shouldHireGardener(): 0.022f - spread across map
archetypes.engagement_style: Map control and denial. Scouts shake all trees for bullets. Secure neutral tree clusters. Deny enemy access to bullet sources.

archetypes.name: Mid-Game Power Spike
archetypes.philosophy: Conserve resources early, then unleash massive coordinated attack around round 1000-1500 when opponent is vulnerable. Timed VP donation backup plan.
key_changes: Update BulletSpending.shouldHireGardener(): 0.015f early, spike to 0.04f at round 800
Update BulletSpending.shouldBuildSoldier(): 0.008f early, spike to 0.05f at round 1000
Update BulletSpending.shouldPlantTree(): 0.04f early, reduce to 0.01f at round 1000
Update BulletSpending.getReserveForRound(): Very high early (250f), drop to 30f at round 1000
Update BulletSpending.getDonateAmount(): Backup VP at round 2200 if elimination failing
archetypes.engagement_style: Defensive/conservative early. At round 1000, all-in coordinated push with pentad shots. Overwhelm before opponent can react.
